`clever addon providers show` now takes `--org <org-id|org-name>`. When it's set, the provider and its plans are looked up for that organisation. Without it, the command behaves as before.

`npm run validate` passes (lint, format, types, docs check). I didn't run the command against the API.

- **Code:** I added `org: orgaIdOrNameOption`, the same shared option `addon create` uses, in `src/commands/addon/addon.providers.show.command.js`. The handler resolves the org to an owner ID and passes it to `Addon.getProvider()`, which already accepted one.
- **Docs:** `npm run docs` regenerated `addon.docs.md` and `skills/clever-tools/references/full-documentation.md`.
- **Reverted file:** `fix-all` reformatted `.claude/settings.json`, which isn't part of this change, so I reverted it.
- **Dependencies:** `node_modules` was missing, so I ran `npm ci` to be able to lint and validate.

I haven't committed anything. Per `AGENTS.md`, a PR needs an existing issue to close, so tell me the issue number if there is one.
